items.title: 53342_Cozy Cole oral history interview
items.q: Gene Redd on vibes; John Thomas on piano; the same two guitar players, Edwin Connally on bass, and that was done about a month later in June of '59.

ctx.x: Yeah, that was my first wife.

And the second is George Kelly again, Gene Redd on vibes; John Thomas on piano; the same two guitar players, Edwin Connally on bass, and that was done about a month later in June of '59. So that's that. So did you do a lot of travelling then after "Topsy" came out?
Oh yes, I did quite a bit of travelling with "Topsy."
